archetypes.name: dyn-grammar-compat
archetypes.rationale: Shared grammar migration spans terminal and whole-document compatibility paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new plan grammar and migrated consumers for behavior drift. Focus on fence handling, terminal contiguous trailers, blank-tolerant preflight metadata, and Gate B whole-document scans. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
